svg.data-weight: 16 kg with PSUs and fans (datasheet); QSG says 15.3 kg
svg.data-input-dc: -40 to -75 VDC, 40 A max per PSU
svg.data-software: ONIE preinstalled; ONL and commercial NOS supported
svg.data-certifications: UL/CSA 60950-1 and IEC 62368-1 safety, CB, CE, EN 55032 Class A, FCC Part 15 Class A, RoHS 2.0, WEEE

g.data-description: QSG Front LEDs callout 1 - LED1 (top) - Blue (100G). The QSFP-DD ports run at one rate here, so this lamp has one lit state and the guide names no other
g.title: led-port-0-a

g.data-description: QSG Front LEDs callouts 1 and 2 - LED2 - Blue (all lanes linked / link), Off (not all lanes linked), Blinking (activity). Two things to note. Off is a MEANING on this lamp, not the absence of one: a partly linked QSFP reads dark, where the AGR400 lights the same condition Red, so the two sisters differ and `off` carries the sentence here. And the guide words the lit state differently for the two families - "all lanes linked" for QSFP-DD, "link" for QSFP28 - while the Traditional Chinese text of the same guide says "all lanes linked" for both; one vocabulary is modelled, named `linked`
g.title: led-port-0-b
